verdict.rationale: Crossmint documents outbound webhooks for wallet, payment, and user events, plus onchain-enforced spending rules and permissions. These do not deliver the story. Webhooks are notification building blocks that a developer would have to wire into their own automation. Spending rules and the 'policy engine' constrain what an agent may spend; they do not trigger actions when events occur. No user-definable rule system that fires actions automatically on events is evidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
